content.value: Design a pile cap for a columń 18 inch square exerting a load of 250 kips. Each pile has the bearing capacity of 75 kips and 18 inch in diameter. Use $f _ { y } = 6 0 0 0 0$ psi and $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 3 0 0 0 ~ \mathsf { p s i }$ . Show the reinforcement details.

Design a continuous footing with foundation grade beam as shown in figure below. All columns have size of 18 inch x 18 inch, and allowable bearing capacity of soil is 1.25 tsf. Use $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 3 0 0 0$ psi and $f _ { y } = 6 0 0 0 0$ psi. Show the reinforcement details.

A structure is supported on six columns arranged as shown in figure below. All columns are 15 inch x 15 inch in size. The load on each column is shown in the figure. Design a raft foundation (slab-beam type). The allowable bearing capacity of soil is 1.0 tsf. Use $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 3 0 0 0$ psi and $f _ { y } = 6 0 0 0 0$ psi. Show the reinforcement details.
